up: Find all compound records reported in the specific document with the identifier CHEMBL5726550. Return the compound's ChEMBL identifier (as `compound_chembl_id`), the internal molecule numeric identifier (as `molregno`), the document's title, and the PubMed identifier (as `pubmed_id`). Ensure each qualifying molecule appears only once in the result set.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.molecule_chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.molregno, d.title, d.pubmed_id
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726550';
